name: OnePA Team
subject: Tell Congress to end the tax giveaways feeding billionaire power
body:
We’re organizing to make billionaires pay their fair share and make Congress answer to our communities. | |
---
Peter, **We work, pay our taxes, and organize for public schools, affordable homes, and health care our families can count on.** We deserve a government that invests in those priorities. But the billionaires using their fortunes to influence our elections expect Congress to keep putting them first. **Elon Musk has poured $276 million into Republican groups since July, bringing his total political giving this election cycle to roughly $366 million.** That makes him the biggest known donor in this year’s midterms. He’s spending that fortune to keep Republicans in control of the decisions that shape our lives. We know how billionaire power works here in Pennsylvania. Jeffrey Yass is Pennsylvania’s richest man, and one of the GOP’s largest donors in the country. We’ve organized against Yass’s efforts to divert public dollars into private school vouchers. Our communities have had to fight for school funding while wealthy donors bankroll politicians willing to advance their agenda. Trump and his allies have rewarded the billionaire class with tax giveaways while cutting the health care and food assistance our neighbors depend on. **We’re demanding that Congress reverse those giveaways and tax the enormous fortunes that let people like Musk accumulate even more wealth and political power.** [**Tell Congress to tax Elon Musk and the ultra-rich, reverse Trump’s tax giveaways, and invest in the communities lawmakers were elected to serve.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_d6sfLs7Ed_dflUE_cLBPDmga_uWTsnoRGXSWkjzWZCOwA-7qIkJg16js66_xbN9hYEsjs9JycMZkWQ-WNbLcRpqXFIwdgi9iQrolJiLdyRKud5KAI8f3SlS0-KfT9e_B8sD4S-n4qS-PyroSVcVihTfIL0av45yNQE0ecP8TmOLreVBelDJ1A4_qP93t1MvC7Wv2sQzKyWZVFvW-Rd5_g-WpPMADq0rA-BDE1i2dTJd5G66mFtoAKGCEOdgjYQvjNS22q5Ul6Zn6K5yA1jPM_Y3Ys-T1yVlUBuxhhsuX0pMh2XruEfzZXYJpvXX3q6Evp6Zx6EpdtWm9bBLx8sbQw0ElmaxCsKRurWjVCmoLlkDLGbsFlTcKJE2AgkOxOeSrZNgSDKri5gTy7XhydVlvkJg1Z92VD2BO9_MsGncJoOIC19kQg706w1nzI9_jTy0j_O1KY2tv2UIQIGj1X-JKZ/4v5/0tUgfYBJT7qIZ9MTUwq_lA/h0/h001.NKQXfxMSZeoCu4yixCNR9M-Zl6UMZ_Vu41MLEo8Pi4k) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_d6sfLs7Ed_dflUE_cLBPDmga_uWTsnoRGXSWkjzWZCOwA-7qIkJg16js66_xbN9hYEsjs9JycMZkWQ-WNbLcRpqXFIwdgi9iQrolJiLdyRKud5KAI8f3SlS0-KfT9e_B8sD4S-n4qS-PyroSVcVihTfIL0av45yNQE0ecP8TmOLreVBelDJ1A4_qP93t1MvDm2DTzGODcVoma_qdhJUdiTZNlvKDb86ATZ8I-AuQNmLmNb9omJEeZ7Sb_xS7Xk-3ubRFUqkQxP3YglocKlCPW3FPv7kq0gJaDcqD3z8gGdU5bq2NrEfIuJcPgH5m36jmRlqcIbTypl3v8cxVyAGpJ2onryS1guYGlD33YHkPlptNGLjWnBywNnk1Kyyp0far0vn7Hmw1YglyVP2WAHjRFZu-YIVOJfluEpgeoRxy1P_QqBXOXzros0wFHei4EfLjYvQdAm70Fhs40Pzaflp82/4v5/0tUgfYBJT7qIZ9MTUwq_lA/h1/h001.S600NjleGoKAmk9TDWFoxBIelwodmsNgjszGy5xFvFM)

**We’ve already seen the damage Musk is willing to do with government power. Through DOGE, he helped dismantle public services and attack the workers who deliver them.** Now he’s financing the politicians who can carry that draconian agenda forward.
Every tax giveaway to the wealthy strengthens a system our members are organizing to change. We pay the price when public resources are stripped from our neighborhoods, and then we face the same wealthy interests spending millions to keep their allies in office.
We’re building the collective power to demand something better. OnePA members bring neighbors into action, develop leaders, and organize Black and working-class communities to hold elected officials accountable. Every person who joins this demand helps make clear that Congress will have to answer for whose interests it serves.
Taxing extreme wealth can help fund the schools, housing, care, and services our families need. **We’re demanding that lawmakers end the special treatment billionaires have secured for themselves and make the wealthiest people contribute to the communities that helped create their fortunes.**
[**Send your message to Congress today. Demand an end to Trump’s tax giveaways and make Musk, other billionaires, and big corporations pay their fair share.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_d6sfLs7Ed_dflUE_cLBPDmga_uWTsnoRGXSWkjzWZCOwA-7qIkJg16js66_xbN9hYEsjs9JycMZkWQ-WNbLcRpqXFIwdgi9iQrolJiLdyRKud5KAI8f3SlS0-KfT9e_B8sD4S-n4qS-PyroSVcVihTfIL0av45yNQE0ecP8TmOLreVBelDJ1A4_qP93t1MvCpRDz5ug6OZ3K6hmBf8J1mrJptFPoyBw1ASyj3XboO8Mus7e8hpIhQyExciWfZB011XeZbYa2fULHYfSU8E4o35XpBXi5jiZirdwfgDqMeBmjf7vV7zStF0ByHTPzDvMc5Xv9YosMWjo39hrdgwMI86ntLqi7VIqD0GfAGFaquNVdp6dwx2GutmmUY4H8c2U6N8XNpUQDzMPr3Hi-R4E9j03FrZub4o5_CgekUg63bxr4dLjQ4WP57UhWuhCFf100dzHFvcvfqxIOJGB_7f8Kp/4v5/0tUgfYBJT7qIZ9MTUwq_lA/h2/h001.26hJz2CH2nxuuMHXcQ9nnbQErGFh2yWoUj1pOgEAzZI)
Let’s keep organizing for the future our families deserve.
-OnePA

This will only take a minute, Peter – but I need your full attention:
With just 10 days left and early voting underway, I set a $500,000 goal for this weekend to fuel our voter outreach efforts in North Carolina’s U.S. Senate race.
**Yet as I write this, grassroots support isn’t coming in at the pace needed to reach this goal by tomorrow’s midnight deadline.**
I know I ask a lot of you. I wish I didn’t have to – but after President Trump smeared me at an NC rally _and_ launched a new million-dollar attack ad buy against me this week, I can’t afford not to. He even mentioned that he _might_ come back next week. Senate control hinges on the outcome of this race, and it takes serious resources to reach, persuade and mobilize the voters we need to win.
While my opponent’s getting a lifeline from his biggest MAGA billionaire allies, I’m running a people-powered campaign. **So with time running out, I have no choice but to turn to people like you today:**
[**_Will you please make your first gift of $5 or whatever you can right now to help us hit our goal and win every vote up for grabs in NC?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1742&amount=5&t=9&akid=4864%2E124072%2ESizw2i)**

2. **Democrats are being outspent.** Republican megadonors are pouring money into dozens of races, and we need a surge of grassroots support to compete.

3. The data is clear that **grassroots donations power Democratic victories** , so the more folks chip in, the better off we are.

6. **People literally can’t afford not to change course.** Costs are too high, wages aren’t keeping up, and families are stretched thin. We need leaders who will take Trump’s affordability crisis seriously and actually do something about it.

7. If we win the majority, we can shut down the corrupt, chaotic, and cruel MAGA majority enabling this administration’s worst actions – the militarized and violent ICE raids, the inhumane mass detentions, the cuts to SNAP and Medicaid, the war in Iran – _I could go on!_ **Every seat we hold or flip is another vote against the chaos.**

8. **Oversight, oversight, oversight:** flipping the House means real subpoena power and the ability to demand answers from an administration that thinks it’s untouchable.

9. With a Democratic Congress, **we can protect voting rights** across the country from a President hell-bent on suppressing the vote and interfering in our elections.

10. Last but very much not least, we can **elect incredible Democrats who have a vision** for the future, and who are ready to tackle some of our biggest problems – AI regulation, data privacy protections, out-of-control costs on healthcare, housing, and child care, and so much more.

We need leaders who will take Trump’s affordability crisis seriously and actually do something about it. 7. If you’re anything like me, you’ve probably been thinking about November 3rd, 2026, for nearly two years now.
But I’ve also been thinking about what happens _after_ November 3rd. Not in Congress, but in an entirely different branch of government.
Picture this: On November 3rd, Democrats win back the House and Senate. It’s a resounding, undeniable defeat for Donald Trump and his entire MAGA movement.

name: Sherrod
subject: Worried, but not for the reasons you might think
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada Rosen for Nevada
body:
Thank you for having my back, again and again.
| | |
---
Time is ticking:
We're just under one month out from Election Day, and the pressure is on. But not for the reasons you might think...
The truth is: **I don’t want to let you down.**
_You_ are the heart of this campaign. Since the very beginning, grassroots donors have made it possible to compete with massive spending from special interests. You’ve proven that when working people come together, we can win:
* When Peter Thiel dropped $3.6 million against me in a single week, you helped keep our own ads live.

* When JD Vance personally attacked me, you stood by me and helped this campaign surge ahead.

* And when crypto billionaires decided to put $30 million behind new attack ads spreading lies about me, you helped us fight back.

But this race is far from over, friend.
All eyes are on Ohio, and the money continues to pour in. **In fact, Republican megadonors are spending more here than in Georgia, Alaska, and North Carolina combined. Let that sink in.**
I’m not sharing this to scare you – the polls keep proving that we have what it takes to win – but I’m writing this to remind you just how important you are to this movement.
**In the face of a quarter of a BILLION dollars being spent by Republicans in Ohio, our campaign has been able to stay competitive only because of grassroots donations from folks like you. And right now, I need you to have my back more than ever.**
My past races have taught me that this close to Election Day, resources are what allow a candidate to pull ahead. So we cannot give the GOP an inch.
**_[Today, I’m asking you to split $5 between my campaign and Jacky Rosen’s. I’m counting on you. Will you give what you can to help us flip Ohio and take back the Senate?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142116552/655848342/1703322652?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5962-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDk5Y2M0OS1lNmNmLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3DfN8Lmlf_QbrB05DwIvoQB6IuOArHNboQn-bZ6VcZg=)_**
Thank you for keeping us in this fight,
Sherrod Brown

subject: Just give me a minute of your time
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Aaron Ford
body:
Folks, I know your inbox is probably filled with other campaigns messaging you, but please just give me a minute of your time.
Nate Silver, one of the best election forecasters out there, made a list of the most competitive governors’ races in the country. _Guess who was at the very top?_
**Nevada.**
Look, we knew our race would be a toss-up. But being the MOST competitive one this cycle? That’s a lot of pressure. I won’t pretend it isn’t.
But that’s the deck we were dealt, and we have to fight with everything we’ve got to win.
**There are only 10 days left in this race.** 10 days to reach every voter we can and make sure every Nevadan who wants a better future casts their ballot in support of our campaign.
The money we raise right now will go toward keeping our ads up and fueling our get-out-the-vote efforts in these final days.
MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo and his billionaire backers are outspending us. But if enough members of this team step up now, that won’t matter — we can out-organize their millions.
**_So please, if you can chip in today, it’d be a huge help. Can I count on your $5 donation?_**
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_af_20261024_4_ak](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261024_4_ak.s05w0A&amount=5&refcode=em20261024-1163&t=2&akid=1178%2E127862%2Es6npX8)**

Aaron

The map says landslide. Democrats are defending Senate seats in states Trump has carried comfortably, a House remade in Texas and North Carolina and Missouri, an incumbent party holding every lever in Washington. Republicans are on the verge of a blowout election -- which is precisely why you should study where Donald Trump is spending the final fortnight of October, and what happens to the sound when he gets there.
Presidents heading for a blowout victory do not spend October in states they won by thirty points. This one is running a victory lap through his own home field: Vandalia, Ohio. Clarksville, Tennessee. San Antonio, Texas. Park City, Kansas. Wasilla, Alaska. Greenville, North Carolina. South Carolina. If the base were base-ing, none of these trips would be necessary. The schedule is the first warning. The sound at the rallies is the second...

My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona.

That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day.

I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is.

**Arizona is not lost._Not even close_. But it is not safe either.**

Turning Point PAC is not like anything else in this space. They take decades of grassroots organizing and put real people, like me, into these communities well before Election Day.

We build relationships.
We knock on the same doors more than once.
We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts.

**This is the vision Charlie Kirk built. People on the ground, having real conversations, changing real minds. **

And it is working!

But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona.

**I 'm seeing momentum on the ground, but we have so many more voters to cover. We can't do it without your continued support. **

That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day. I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is. Arizona is not lost.Not even close. But it is not safe either. A new poll just showed Katie Hobbs up by 4 points over Andy Biggs. Four points. That is the entire ballgame, sitting right there behind the doors I have not knocked on yet. Turning Point PAC is not like anything else in this space. They take decades of grassroots organizing and put real people, like me, into these communities well before Election Day. We build relationships. We knock on the same doors more than once. We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts. This is the vision Charlie Kirk built. People on the ground, having real conversations, changing real minds. And it is working! But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona. Case File No DRT-ED-SPIKE · Special File · The Second Spike
Oil Just Hit a Five-Month High. Only a Handful of Ships a Day Are Getting Through Hormuz.
Brent crude jumped to about $114 a barrel this week, up from $104 just a week earlier. On October 18, only four ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz, against a pre-war norm of about 85 a day. For drivers, that means more pain at the pump. For a small group of investors, it means something very different.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Most people experience an oil shock the same way: the number on the gas station sign climbs, and their budget shrinks. But every dollar of that increase goes somewhere. The people who understand where it goes don’t panic when prices jump. Some of them smile.
The evidence board
| | What Changed This Week
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the price.** Brent crude hit about $114 a barrel on October 23, its highest level in five months. A week earlier, it closed at $104.51.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the choke point.** IMF PortWatch recorded just 4 transits through the Strait of Hormuz on October 18, compared with about 85 a day before the war. According to USNI News, citing the International Maritime Organization, there were 27 attacks on commercial ships in October, the most in any month since the conflict began.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the pump.** AAA’s national average was about $4.30 a gallon on October 19, and California averaged $6.40 at the start of the month. Those numbers were set before this week’s jump in crude.
| OUR THEORY
---
When supply is choked, prices rise for everyone who buys energy, and profits rise for those who own it. With U.S. crude trading well below the global benchmark, producers and refiners at home are in an unusually strong position.

Some analysts say the companies supplying that kind of independent power are about to get a lot more attention.

But Vivek Ramaswamy has proven to us time and time again that he has neither of those things.
I refuse to sit by and let a self-serving billionaire ruthlessly hurl disgusting, personal attacks at me and others to get what he wants.

clean_body: Now we have to walk and chew gum at the same time | | | Thank you to everyone who was able to join Monday’s inspiring Fair Fight: Together conversation with Stacey Abrams! Her galvanizing words will be ringing in our ears through Election Day — and beyond: “This is a moment where I know everyone's going to be just laser-focused on November 3. And I want us to stay with that focus. But I also need us to think about November 4, because it's the day after. It's after we have done the work of getting folks elected. That's when the fight takes on its next dimension.” “We are going to win elections, and then we're going to win the future. And so I just want to say thank you to Fair Fight for always doing this work, being in the fight, being in the places where it matters, and helping lift up the voices and the candidates and the stories that create the change that we need.” —Stacey Abrams Take it from Stacey Abrams: We have to walk and chew gum at the same time right now. We have to do everything we can to get out the vote for Democracy Champions through Election Day. But we’re not going anywhere after November 3. So simultaneously, we have to keep strengthening our movement to deliver real progress on voting rights and fair representation — after all the votes are counted and new leaders take office. I know I’ve already reached out today. And I know my team has, too. But this kind of fundraising gap isn’t something we can afford right now. I’m one of just TWO Democratic Governors running for reelection in a state Trump won — and with Republicans fresh off of their sweep here in Pennsylvania in 2024, this Governor’s office is their top target. So if they catch wind of the fact that our fundraising is slowing down? That’s Donald Trump’s golden ticket to unleash his war chest and totally drown us out in the final days of this race. [ ]Derek, I’m not desperate — but I am worried. I don’t want to be entering our final full week of the race in a budget crunch, so please, will you make your first $25 donation before midnight tonight to help us get back on track? Ten days.
That's all the time we have left to beat John Sununu and flip the Senate.
Sununu is Donald Trump's hand-picked candidate. Republicans and their allies are spending more than $66 million to buy this seat and lock in a Senate majority. They have the money. We have the people.
We can't match their cash. But we don't have to. With your help we can outwork them.
Across the Granite State, we've built a grassroots movement driven by neighbors talking to neighbors. I'm grateful to everyone who has been part of this, whether you just tuned in or have been on our team since we launched this campaign 18 months ago.
**[So I have to ask: With ten days remaining in this battleground race, can I count on you to chip in $10 today to help us beat John Sununu and flip the Senate?](https://substack.com/redirect/e2249ca2-9807-4e31-8e4b-7f5af3468ca2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

This race will be close. Every door we knock on and every call we make between now and November 3rd could make the difference, and we can't take anything for granted.
We're in the final sprint, and I need to know you're with us.
Ten days, ten dollars. Folks like you are the reason this campaign is still in the fight.
**[Will you pitch in $10 or whatever you can right now to help us finish this race strong, defend New Hampshire's open Senate seat, and retake the majority in just ten days?](https://substack.com/redirect/e2249ca2-9807-4e31-8e4b-7f5af3468ca2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

As always thank you for your continued support.
I hope to see some of you on the trail in the final stretch.
Onward,

Peter, When I was a teenager playing sax in my dad’s band, I had no idea where my life would take me. Thirty years later, I’d sold out arenas and won a pair of Latin GRAMMYs. If you’d have told me that I went on to quit music altogether to run for Congress, I’d have laughed out loud. If you’d have told me that we’d turn a Trump +18 seat into the country’s most competitive House race, I’d have asked what you were drinking. **And that the President had smeared me online and was spending millions of dollars to defeat me in an election?** It’s safe to say I wouldn’t have seen that one coming either. It’s all true. _Every word._ But this movement has never been about just me. It’s about us, about giving people in South Texas the hope they’ve been denied for so long. **[I’m honored to have your support in this race, Peter, but we are being outspent and can’t close the gap without your support. When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.

Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.

Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.

So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.

And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying nearly 20 bucks for a gallon of fuel. They don’t even believe us.

They're focused on their own wallets – not ours.

And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.

It’s why our prices keep rising, all while the healthcare and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.

I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.

My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning. But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.

I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future. This is going to be the closest and most consequential Senate race this year, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to flip this seat... and that is together.

So I am asking:

body:
For an amazing year

Dear Peter,

It's been a whole year since I sent you the message below.

Since that time, we've made some amazing accomplishments. You helped
me expose Josh Kaul's failing record on crime labs. We received
endorsements from over 80% of Wisconsin sheriffs, another huge
accomplishment. We even had the best initial fundraising quarter for
an attorney general race in Wisconsin history...

And I had a birthday. 😅

But now we're just weeks away from the election, and things are
getting tight. If you're able, please CONSIDER MAKING A CONTRIBUTION
OF $25, $50, OR WHATEVER YOU CAN TO HELP POWER US TO NOVEMBER 3RD.
[https://link.action.erictoney.

Thank you for standing with me this past year. I hope I can count on
you to stay by my side until Election Day.

Eric

_ONE YEAR AGO..._

[https://link.action.erictoney.

Dear friend,

Everything was put into perspective for me two years ago.

I was 39 and had just been told I needed open-heart surgery. Mind you,
I run marathons, so this was never a position I imagined myself being
in.

I promised myself that if I survived that operating table I would do
something with my life to make a difference for Wisconsin, WHICH IS
WHY I AM PROUD TO TELL YOU FIRST THAT I HAVE ENTERED THE RACE TO BE
YOUR NEXT ATTORNEY GENERAL.

You and your families deserve SAFE communities, victims DESERVE
JUSTICE, and criminals deserve to face the REPERCUSSIONS of their
actions. _But under the current AG, Josh Kaul, we aren’t seeing
justice. _

A border that has been too open for too long has allowed our
communities to be flooded with meth and fentanyl, overwhelming our
local resources and resulting in the needless deaths of Wisconsinites.
A_pparently, to Josh Kaul, this is just the new normal..._

IT'S TIME FOR A CHANGE. AND I'M READY TO BRING THAT CHANGE.

Please consider helping me in these critical early weeks by
contributing $1,000, or any generous amount up to $20,000 per person.
[https://link.action.erictoney.

This isn’t a vanity campaign; I have the tried-and-true credentials
it takes to be successful. As a District Attorney and having been
President of the Wisconsin District Attorneys Association, I always
put public safety over politics.

I’m proud to have worked across party lines with a Democrat Governor
and a Republican Legislature to deliver pay raises for our prosecutors
and public defenders, as well as create over 50 new prosecutor
positions where they were needed the most.

_With your support, we can turn our state around, starting on Day One,
to make our communities safer, restore competence to the crime labs,
confront the drug crisis with the urgency it demands, and protect
Wisconsin._

Are you with me?

[https://link.action.erictoney.

ERIC TONEY
_Republican Candidate for Wisconsin Attorney General _

[https://link.action.erictoney.

<< CONTRIBUTE NOW >>
[https://link.action.erictoney.

name: Farewell President Trump
subject: Do not make me say goodbye.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Never Surrender, Inc
body:
This could be my final week with you and the MAGA Movement.
| | | |
# **FAREWELL TO TRUMP**
---
[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
This was hard to write.
**_In just 1 week, we might have to say goodbye to each other forever..._**
That’s if we lose the Congressional Majority on Election Night.
On day 1, Democrats will file the Articles of Impeachment against me for the THIRD TIME. But this time, they will have the votes — the votes to lock me out of the White House and throw away the key.
**_Could you even begin to fathom MAGA without Trump??_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Once they kick me out, they’ll reverse everything I’ve done to Make America Great Again over the past two years.
Borders will open and criminal illegal aliens will flood into our country AGAIN.
Cities like Washington DC will roar with crime AGAIN.
Social Security tax will go up to an all time high AGAIN.
And this time, the American dream might slip away for every young American and all future generations to come.
This will break my heart.
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
My job is far from over, and the last thing I want is for the Democrats to unleash terror on the great American people.
**_[So I am asking you, from the bottom of my heart, not to let them do it.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
You have stood with me when nobody else would. You have taken the hits, the insults, the lies, and you have never backed down. That’s why we’re still here. That’s why America still has a chance.
But one week is nothing. If our people sit this one out, it is over. No second chance. No do-over. They get the Majority, and they’ll obliterate all of the hard work that we’ve accomplished.
I need you in this fight. Not later. Now. One gift from you keeps our Majority alive and keeps me in this office, fighting for you.
Please. Do not make me say goodbye. Stand with me one more time.
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
